cases.provenance: A user reported this defect after the reviewed pull request, and a later fix repaired it.
cases.description:
Hi,
 
I wanted to renew my cert manually today and ./bitwarden.sh renewcert always told me "Unknown command."
Seems like there is a typo in Line 138 of the bitwarden.sh script. (should be "renewcert" instead of "renewcrt" i guess)

Reference:
https://github.com/bitwarden/server/blob/6d8e37ebf634ef73ba7e99f26ef60ffacb59d74e/scripts/bitwarden.sh#L138

Kind regards

evidence.eventual_fix_title: Fix command name for renewcert (from renewcrt)
evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement:
Fix command name for renewcert (from renewcrt)

Fixes #1126 
Command name should match the help page and list commands output. Also fixed help site link.
evidence.eventual_fix_diff:
commit 360be1245fca746d06e92bf9e6d3b764f251ab67
Author: Chad Scharf <3904944+cscharf@users.noreply.github.com>
Date:   Tue Feb 2 09:23:38 2021 -0500

    Fix command name for renewcert (from renewcrt) (#1128)
    
    Command name should match the help page and list commands output. Also fixed help site link.

diff --git a/scripts/bitwarden.sh b/scripts/bitwarden.sh
index dc5425b55..f08811ae5 100755
--- a/scripts/bitwarden.sh
+++ b/scripts/bitwarden.sh
@@ -96,7 +96,7 @@ renewcert
 rebuild
 help
 
-See more at https://help.bitwarden.com/article/install-on-premise/#script-commands
+See more at https://bitwarden.com/help/article/install-on-premise/#script-commands
 
 EOT
 }
@@ -135,7 +135,7 @@ case $1 in
         checkOutputDirExists
         $SCRIPTS_DIR/run.sh stop $OUTPUT $COREVERSION $WEBVERSION
         ;;
-    "renewcrt")
+    "renewcert")
         checkOutputDirExists
         $SCRIPTS_DIR/run.sh renewcert $OUTPUT $COREVERSION $WEBVERSION
         ;;
